The Feed & Discovery Audit for bainluck.com is complete. I have evaluated the home feed, category pages, navigation, and mobile experience. 

The audit revealed several critical data quality issues, particularly with unresolved markets showing 100%/0% probabilities and future games being marked as "FINAL". The search functionality also requires significant improvement, as it currently only shows trending topics and does not execute actual searches. However, the MLB Championship Grid and live event detail pages are exceptionally well-executed.
